FUTURE ROADMAP

Multiphase engineering trajectory transitioning FocusBot from experimental bench prototype to an autonomous commercial desktop ecosystem.

PHASE 01 // ACTIVE IN FLIGHT
HORIZON: Q1 2026

Core Embodied Architecture & Proof-of-Concept

Establishment of the physical pan-tilt 2-DOF companion chassis, edge-based OpenCV activity inference (distinguishing textbook study from mobile scrolling), and low-latency conversational synapse powered by Google Gemini 2.0 API.

PHASE 02 // HARDWARE TELEMETRY & EXPANSION
HORIZON: Q2–Q3 2026

On-Device TPU Quantization & Inductive Wireless Power

Migration from micro-servos to ultra-quiet magnetic field-oriented control (FOC) gimbal motors to eliminate actuator buzz during deep study sessions. Integration of an inductive charging desktop dock and quantized 8-bit MobileNetV4 models for 100% on-device vision inference without cloud dependencies.

PHASE 03 // MULTI-USER COGNITIVE SYNAPSE
HORIZON: 2027

Affective HRI, Multi-Occupant Arbitration & Longitudinal Habit Learning

Longitudinal multi-session adaptation that learns an individual's idiosyncratic productivity rhythms over weeks. Addition of multi-occupant gaze arbitration for shared library desks and specialized ADHD cognitive scaffolding modes.
